source: MIDAS/MIMES Belize 2026 project — RUSLE soil-loss factors derived from open-source rasters via scripts/pre-process/rusle/compute.ts
license: Composite of CC BY 4.0 (SoilGrids 2.0 / Copernicus DEM GLO-30 / ESA WorldCover v200) + ESDAC custom terms for GloREDa (joined per-polygon values are redistributable; the raw R-factor raster is not). Methodology assumption (P = 1.0) carries no license obligations.
citation: Panagos et al. 2017 (GloREDa global R-factor, JRC ESDAC); Hengl et al. 2017 (SoilGrids 2.0, ISRIC); Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Copernicus / ESA); ESA WorldCover v200 (ESA / VITO); Wischmeier & Smith 1978 (K nomograph, USDA AH-537); McCool et al. 1987 (LS formulation, in Renard et al. 1997 AH-703); Borrelli et al. 2017 (C lookup, Nature Communications 8:2013).
title: Placencia watersheds RUSLE factors
description: Per-watershed R / K / LS / C / P / A (annual soil loss in t/ha/yr) for the 6 Placencia watershed polygons. Computed offline via scripts/pre-process/rusle/compute.ts from GloREDa, SoilGrids 2.0, Copernicus DEM, and ESA WorldCover.
notes: DRAFTED 2026-05-26 — first run of the RUSLE ETL. v1 LS uses local-slope approximation (slope-length = one DEM pixel); upgrade path is whitebox-workflows D8 flow accumulation. P = 1.0 is a methodology assumption (no global P raster exists). K = 0 / A = 0 for polygons whose SoilGrids window is ocean-masked (none for Placencia mainland).
